patch_description: Replace the randomized greedy sampling with a beam search over partial schedules. At each step, for each beam candidate, evaluate ALL remaining transactions by their single-step lookahead makespan (computed with get_opt_seq_cost on the extended prefix), keep the top-k lowest-cost extensions, and run many randomized restarts (each seeded with a different starting transaction plus randomized tie-breaking) to escape local optima. Beam search with full one-step lookahead is fundamentally stronger than random sampling because it systematically explores the best extensions rather than sampling a few random ones, while multiple restarts with shuffled seeds provide diversity.
